text.description_html:
Michael Healy MH1071, Sea Scallop Front Door Knocker in Brass

This elegant Polished Brass Sea Scallop Door Knocker is perfect for any beach-side home. The Sea Scallop Front Door Knocker is beautiful and features excellent craftsmanship, so you can be sure it will stand the test of time. The Sea Scallop Front Door Knocker in Brass was designed by Michael Healy and the brass and bronze patina finish highlights the detailing of this knocker. It comes packaged with the mounting hardware for a wood or metal door.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Available in 3 finishes:
Polished Brass with Brown Patina Nickel Silver Oiled Bronze

Also Available: smaller 4" Polished Brass Bay Scallop Door Knocker

Features and Specifications of the Polished Brass Sea Scallop Premium Door Knocker:

  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Finish: Polished Brass with Brown Patina
  • Height: 5-1/4"
  • Width: 5-1/2"
  • Mounting Hole Centers: 3-1/2"
  • Projection Off Door: 2"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
